use.title: Use BG Shell
use.description: Move terminal sessions to the background and reopen them from any device.

bgShell.movedDescription: It keeps running. Open BG Shell from any device to pick it up.
bgShell.moveFailed: Could not move to BG Shell: {{error}}
bgShell.moveFailedDetached: The session is still running on the server for now. Reopen BG Shell to check on it.
bgShell.notConnected: This terminal is not connected, so there is nothing to keep running.
bgShell.title: BG Shell
bgShell.subtitle: Sessions that keep running when you close the page
bgShell.emptyBody: Right-click a connected terminal tab and choose "Move to BG Shell". The session keeps running on the server, and you can pick it up here after a refresh, a reboot or from another device.
bgShell.selectSession: Select a session to open it
bgShell.awayHint: This session is attached to a terminal tab somewhere else. It returns here when that tab disconnects.
bgShell.needsAuthHint: The server lost its sign-in for this session. It reconnects as soon as you open BG Shell while signed in.
bgShell.endedHint: This session has ended. The last screen is shown below.
bgShell.terminateBody: This closes the SSH session, stops every process running in it and deletes it from BG Shell.
bgShell.resizeHint: Sized for another device. Click or type to fit this window.
bgShell.connectionLost: Connection to the server lost. Reconnecting...
bgShell.panelHint: Right-click a terminal tab and choose "Move to BG Shell" to keep it running here.
bgShell.imageClipboardUnavailable: This browser cannot read images from the clipboard
bgShell.imageClipboardEmpty: No image found in the clipboard
bgShell.imageNotPasted: Image uploaded, but the session was not available to paste it: {{path}}
bgShell.confirmTerminateBody: "{{label}}" and everything running in it will be gone for good. This cannot be undone.
bgShell.deleteBodyRunning: This ends the SSH session, stops every process running in it and removes it from BG Shell. This cannot be undone.
bgShell.deleteBodyEnded: This removes the ended session and its last screen from BG Shell.
bgShell.newSessionHint: Pick a host. Its session starts in the background right away.
bgShell.noHosts: No SSH hosts yet. Add one in Hosts first.
bgShell.needsSignInBody: Finish signing in in the terminal that opened, then right-click its tab → Move to BG Shell.

terminalToolbar.uploadImage: Upload an image to the host
